name: AlUla
short_description: Ancient history meets modern art in a stunning desert landscape.
full_description: AlUla is a breathtaking destination combining UNESCO heritage sites like Hegra with architectural wonders like Maraya. It offers a unique balance between cultural discovery, adventure, and desert tranquility.

shopping_and_arts.name: AlJadidah Arts District
shopping_and_arts.experience_summary: A walkable vibrant district filled with art galleries, murals, and design shops.
shopping_and_arts.signature_dish: Shrimp Musakhan and Hummus with Pine Nuts
shopping_and_arts.top_activity: Walking through the world's largest hand-painted carpet on the street
shopping_and_arts.local_tip: Visit 'Somewhere' for an outdoor dining experience surrounded by palm trees.

shopping_and_arts.name: Old Town Market
shopping_and_arts.experience_summary: A traditional market street with local artisans and heritage crafts.
shopping_and_arts.signature_dish: Najdi Lamb Kabsa with AlUla citrus twist
shopping_and_arts.top_activity: Buying local dates and citrus products
shopping_and_arts.local_tip: The Pink Camel is famous for their 'Lime and Mint' Macarons; don't miss them!

shopping_and_arts.name: Al Manshiyah Plaza
shopping_and_arts.experience_summary: A lively community hub where locals and tourists meet for food and entertainment.
shopping_and_arts.top_activity: Watching local performances in the open plaza
shopping_and_arts.local_tip: Great place to experience the authentic daily life of AlUla residents.

nature_and_adventure.name: Elephant Rock (Jabal AlFil)
nature_and_adventure.experience_summary: A massive 52-meter high natural sandstone elephant-shaped formation.
nature_and_adventure.top_activity: Stargazing around the fire pits at night
nature_and_adventure.local_tip: Go just before sunset to see the rock change colors, then stay for the stars.

nature_and_adventure.name: Hegra (Madain Saleh)
nature_and_adventure.experience_summary: The first UNESCO World Heritage site in Saudi Arabia with over 100 Nabataean tombs.
nature_and_adventure.top_activity: Taking the Vintage Land Rover tour between the tombs
nature_and_adventure.local_tip: Wear comfortable walking shoes and bring sunglasses for the desert glare.

nature_and_adventure.name: Hot Air Balloon Ride
nature_and_adventure.experience_summary: Float over the majestic mountains and heritage sites of AlUla at sunrise.
nature_and_adventure.top_activity: Seeing the sunrise over the Hijaz mountains from above
nature_and_adventure.local_tip: This is a seasonal activity (mostly during winter); book months in advance.

heritage_and_landmarks.name: Maraya Building
heritage_and_landmarks.experience_summary: The world's largest mirrored building, reflecting the stunning desert landscape.
heritage_and_landmarks.local_tip: You need a restaurant reservation to enter the Maraya area if you don't have a concert ticket.

heritage_and_landmarks.name: Jabal Ikmah
heritage_and_landmarks.experience_summary: An open-air library of ancient inscriptions dating back to the Lihyanite kingdom.
heritage_and_landmarks.top_activity: Learning about ancient Arabic writing styles
heritage_and_landmarks.local_tip: The lighting in the morning is perfect for seeing the deep carvings in the rocks.

heritage_and_landmarks.name: AlUla Old Town
heritage_and_landmarks.experience_summary: A labyrinth of 900 mud-brick houses and a 10th-century castle.
heritage_and_landmarks.top_activity: Climbing up to the AlUla Castle for a view of the oasis
heritage_and_landmarks.local_tip: The guided 'rawi' tour is the best way to hear the real stories of the families who lived here.

travel_tips: Book heritage tours (Hegra, Dadan) in advance as they sell out quickly.
Visit Maraya during sunset to see the building 'disappear' into the mountains.
The desert gets cold at night during winter; always carry a warm jacket.
AlJadidah is best explored on foot to enjoy the street art and galleries.
Respect the silence of the desert; it's part of the AlUla magic.
